name: Ayumi-chan no Natsuyasumi
original_name: あゆみちゃんのなつやすみ
source:
Yumi-Chan is a bright and cheerful young girl in *th grade. One day during summer vacation her friend Miyuki-chan invites her over to their pool.

Miyuki-chan's dad is also home.

Something was added to her orange juice, she was taken to the bedroom  to rest...
